ages.title: Upcoming age milestones

what.40: Long-term care premiums start (no filing needed).
what.60: If pay drops on re-employment after retirement, consider same-day loss and re-acquisition to lower the standard remuneration immediately.
what.65: Long-term care premiums stop (moves to the municipal care insurance; no filing needed).
what.70: Pension coverage ends. No filing if pay is unchanged (handled by the Japan Pension Service); otherwise file the Report of Worker Attaining Age 70 (70歳到達届) within 5 days.
what.75: Health coverage ends (moves to the late-stage elderly medical system). File the Coverage-end Report (資格喪失届) within 5 days. Dependents need to join another plan such as National Health Insurance.

ages.effectNote: Born on the 1st, so the age is treated as reached in the previous month ({{y}}-{{m}}).
ages.empty: No one reaches a milestone in this period.
ages.hint: Only current employees are shown. Ages 40, 65 and 75 apply to health insurance members; age 70 to pension members. Filings are a guide.

hint.rule: Uses the average pay (paid in money + in kind) paid in April, May and June. Months with fewer than 17 payment basis days, the month of joining mid-period and months of leave of absence are excluded. If all three are excluded, the previous amount stays.

export.title: 1. Export
export.lead: Exports one row per employee per month for employees employed during the selected period. Entered months have numbers and missing months are blank, so the file also works as a template.
export.hint: Encoded as UTF-8 with BOM (opens directly in Excel). Up to 24 months.

import.title: 2. Import
import.lead: After you choose a file, a review screen appears. Nothing is saved until you press Import.

import.hasErrors: Some rows have problems, so nothing can be imported. Fix the CSV and choose it again (nothing was saved).
import.nothing: There is nothing to import (all rows match saved records or are blank).

contract.title: Employment contract
contract.empty: No contract yet. Used to decide part-time coverage and more.
contract.overwrite: A contract starting {{from}} already exists. Press "Overwrite" to replace it.

field.minimumWageReduction: Has a minimum wage reduction permit
field.renewalPrecedent: Others on similar contracts at this office have been renewed
field.noExtensionAgreed: Both parties agreed in writing (email OK) not to extend beyond the first period

candidate.hourly: Suggestion: hourly × weekly hours × 52 ÷ 12 = {{amount}} yen (click to use)
candidate.daily: Suggestion: daily × days = {{amount}} yen (click to use)

more.open: + Student, minimum wage permit, dispatch, note (only if applicable)

hint.copied: Copied from the current contract. Change only what changed.

hours.month: Monthly hours are divided by 52/12 to get weekly hours.
hours.year: Yearly hours are divided by 52 to get weekly hours.
hours.cycle: For schedules that vary by week. The cycle total is averaged per week.

hint.scheduledWage: Scheduled wage: base pay and allowances. Excludes one-off pay, bonuses, overtime/holiday/night premiums, attendance, commuting and family allowances.
hint.expected: Expected monthly pay: the amount on the Application to Enroll (資格取得届). Scheduled wage plus expected overtime, commuting allowance, etc. (copied from the scheduled wage if empty).
hint.periodEnd: Leave blank for no fixed term.
hint.student: Daytime students are not covered as short-time workers (evening, correspondence, part-time school and students on leave are).

special.daily: Insured from the day employment continues beyond one month.
special.seasonal: Insured from the start if planned to continue beyond 4 months. Enter the end date.
special.temporaryBusiness: Insured from the start if planned to continue beyond 6 months. Enter the end date.

hint.shortPeriod: This contract is 2 months or shorter. If the contract says it will (or may) be renewed, or there is a precedent below, the employee is insured from the start, unless both parties agreed otherwise.
hint.shortPeriodChange: If renewal becomes expected later, add a new contract starting on the agreement date and update the renewal. The employee is insured from that day.

warning.beforeHire: Starts before the hire date (can still be saved).

error.expectedInKind: Enter the amount in digits (0 if none).
error.periodBeforeFrom: The end date is before the start date.

category.ageHint: Loss of coverage by age (pension at 70, health at 75) is shown in the monthly coverage below.

reason.threeQuarters: Weekly hours {{work}} and monthly days {{days}} are both at least 3/4 of a regular worker ({{std}}, {{stdDays}} days).
reason.shortTimeRequirements: Insured as a short-time worker: specified applicable office, {{minHours}}+ hours a week ({{work}}), not a student.
reason.optedIn: A specified reduced-wage worker who requested to be insured.
reason.notSpecific: The office is not a specified applicable office, so not insured.
reason.under20h: Weekly hours are under {{minHours}} ({{work}}), so not insured.
reason.student: A daytime student, so not insured.
reason.lowWage: Scheduled wage ({{wage}} yen) is under the wage requirement ({{wageMin}} yen a month, until Sep 2026), so not insured.
reason.reducedWage: A specified reduced-wage worker (minimum wage reduction permit, scheduled wage {{wage}} yen under {{reducedWageMin}} yen) without a request to be insured, so not insured.
reason.daily: Day laborer: not insured until employment continues beyond one month.
reason.shortTerm: Contract of 2 months or less with no expected renewal, so not insured. Insured from the day employment continues beyond the period.
reason.seasonal: Seasonal work planned for 4 months or less, so not insured.
reason.temporaryBusiness: Temporary business planned for 6 months or less, so not insured.
reason.noContract: No employment contract in effect today.
reason.noStandard: The full-time schedule in office settings is blank, so the 3/4 rule cannot be judged.

below.hours: Weekly hours are below 3/4 of a regular worker ({{work}} of {{std}}).
below.days: Monthly days are below 3/4 of a regular worker ({{days}} of {{stdDays}} days).
below.both: Weekly hours ({{work}} of {{std}}) and monthly days ({{days}} of {{stdDays}} days) are both below 3/4 of a regular worker.

fold.inKind: Enter the expected in-kind amount (housing, meals, etc.)

dependent.title: Dependents
dependent.thirdInsured: Becomes a Category III insured person of the National Pension

household.spouseIncome: Annual income of a spouse who is not a dependent
household.fromRecords: (from {{months}} months of pay and the last year's bonuses)
household.unknown: Cannot calculate without pay records. Enter it via Edit.
household.insuredIncomeHint: Leave blank to calculate from pay and bonus records. Used on the filing and for the "less than half" check.
household.spouseIncomeHint: Fill in when the spouse is not a dependent and children etc. are added. Dependents go to the spouse with the higher income.

field.relationshipConfirmed: Relationship confirmed with family register etc.
field.disabled: Person with a disability (limit becomes 1.8 million yen)
field.contractHoursClear: Working hours are clearly stated (not "by shift")

relationship.otherChild: Other child (not biological or adopted, e.g. a stepchild)

incomeBasis.contract: Judge by employment contract (salary only, from 2026-04-01)

candidate.contract: Suggestion: hourly × weekly hours × 52 + allowances × 12 + bonus = {{amount}} yen (click to use)
candidate.from_acquired: Suggestion: coverage start {{date}} (when filed with the acquisition)

hint.address: Address on the residence record. Required when living apart.
hint.monthly: Enter a monthly amount to get an annual suggestion (108,333 yen/month is about 1.3 million/year).
hint.income: Expected over the next year, including non-taxable income such as disability/survivor pensions, unemployment and sickness benefits.
hint.contract: Annual income expected from the wages in the employment contract (including allowances and bonuses). Only for people with salary income only, who must declare this on the filing.
hint.contractPeriodEnd: Leave blank for no fixed term. Contracts ending within one year of becoming a dependent cannot use this method.
hint.startReason: May be left blank when filed together with the Application to Enroll (資格取得届).
hint.to: For death, enter the day after the date of death.
hint.deleteVsEnd: When someone stops being a dependent, enter the end date instead of deleting. Delete only to fix mistakes.

verdict.disclaimer: Suggested as of the date the person became a dependent. The final decision is made by the Japan Pension Service.

issue.age75: People 75 or older move to the late-stage elderly medical care system.
issue.overLimit: Annual income is at or above the limit.
issue.overInsured: Living together and earning more than this employee.
issue.halfOrMore: Living together and earning half or more of this employee's income (may still be accepted).
issue.insuredIncomeUnknown: This employee's income is unknown, so the "less than half" check cannot be done.
issue.overRemittance: Living apart and income is at or above the yearly remittance.
issue.noRemittance: Living apart but no remittance amount entered.

contractIssue.notYet: The contract method starts 2026-04-01 (judged by expected income).
contractIssue.shortContract: Contract ends within a year, so the contract method cannot be used (judged by expected income).
contractIssue.unclearHours: Hours are unclear, so the contract method cannot be used (judged by expected income).
contractIssue.unclearAllowances: Allowances are unclear, so the contract method cannot be used (judged by expected income).

revision.title: SMR revision candidates
revision.lead: Candidates for SMR revision after a pay change (随時改定, zuiji kaitei) and revision after maternity/childcare leave (産休・育休終了時改定), based on payroll records. Only those starting from {{from}} are shown (the 2-year limitation period as a guide).

revision.noPension: Not covered by pension in the revision month
revision.waiting: Can be judged after {{n}} more month(s) of records.

status.followedByChildcare: Childcare leave started the day after maternity leave, so this is judged when childcare leave ends.

hint.maternity: Requires the employee's request. If remuneration goes down, also guide them to the special measure for the child-rearing period.
hint.childcare: Requires the employee's request. If remuneration goes down, also guide them to the special measure for the child-rearing period.

annual.formula: Annual average {{b}} yen = average fixed wages of the 3 months {{fixed}} yen + average non-fixed wages {{nonFixed}} yen ({{n}} months). The regular average is {{a}} yen.
annual.keepsAll: With the annual average, neither insurance moves from the current grade in the direction of the change, so there is no revision (no filing; the current grade stays).
annual.incomplete: Some of the previous 9 months have no record (only the entered months are used).
annual.seasonalHint: Use this only when overtime etc. rises (or falls) at the same time every year because of the nature of the business or department (e.g. accounting at year-end, seasonal industries). One-off special raises, a temporarily busy period, commuting allowance changes after moving, and revisions after maternity or childcare leave are not eligible.
annual.seasonal: This difference occurs every year because of the nature of the work (busy or quiet season)
annual.consent: The employee agreed to use the annual average (get a consent form every time)
annual.hint: Write "年間平均" in the remarks of the monthly change notification and attach the statement (form example 1) and the consent form (form example 2). For employees who do not consent, use the normal "Apply".

employeeCsv.title: Import employees (CSV)
employeeCsv.lead: One row per employee with basic data and the first employment contract. Social insurance enrollment and standard remuneration are calculated from the contract and shown for review (columns can override them).

employeeCsv.columnsHint: Required: employee number, last name kana, birth date, hire date, employment type, pay type, weekly hours, monthly days, scheduled wage (and last name for Japanese nationals). Dates as 2026-04-01; hours as 40:00. Values can be the Japanese words or codes (regular, part, hourly, etc.). Leave enrollment blank to decide by category. Basic pension number (10 digits) and insured person number can also be entered.

help.title: Help
help.search: Search by keyword (e.g. in kind, enrollment)

todo.title: To-do list (start here every morning)
todo.body: Items that may need a filing are listed by urgency (now, coming up, missing information). Applications to Enroll (資格取得届), Coverage-end Reports (資格喪失届) and category changes can be handled from the to-do item in a small window. Saving records the enrollment and the filing and removes the item. Age milestones and similar items can be marked as checked and restored from "Show checked".

acquire.title: When someone joins (Application to Enroll, 資格取得届)
acquire.body: Register the employee and add an employment contract to see their insured category (e.g. short-time worker). If they should be insured but are not, the to-do list shows an Application to Enroll. Enter the enrollment date, monthly remuneration and grades in the window. The Standard Monthly Remuneration (SMR) decided on enrollment is saved at the same time.

loss.title: When someone leaves (Coverage-end Report, 資格喪失届)
loss.body: Entering a retirement date fills in the coverage-end date (the next day) and the reason. If a contract change means the person is no longer insured, open the Coverage-end Report window from "Review enrollment" in the to-do list. Reaching age 75 can also be filed from the age milestone item.

payroll.title: Entering payroll records
payroll.body: On the payroll screen, enter the amount paid in money, fixed wages and payment basis days for each month paid. These are used for the annual SMR determination (定時決定) and SMR revisions (随時改定). You can also import them by CSV. "Also enter in-kind pay and details" shows the in-kind, total and retroactive pay columns. For one person and one month, you can also use "Enter a month" on the employee page.

inKind.title: Remuneration provided in kind (housing, dormitories, meals)
inKind.body: On the payroll month screen, press "Also enter in-kind pay and details" and open "Calculate" in the in-kind column. Values are converted to yen with the amounts set by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare for each prefecture. Meals are 0 yen if the employee pays two-thirds or more; housing is the value minus what the employee pays. Moving in mid-month is prorated. The prefecture of the workplace defaults to the office and can be changed.

regular.title: Annual SMR determination (定時決定, Remuneration Report)
regular.body: For employees on July 1 each year, the SMR from September is set from the average pay in April, May and June. Months with fewer than 17 payment basis days (11 for short-time workers) are excluded. From June to August, a link appears under the to-do list.

irregular.title: SMR revision after a pay change (随時改定, Remuneration Change Report)
irregular.body: When fixed wages change and the average of the three months from that month moves the SMR by two grades or more (one grade at the upper or lower limit), the SMR is revised. Candidates appear on the revision candidates screen from payroll records, together with revisions after maternity or childcare leave.

leave.title: Premium exemption for maternity and childcare leave
leave.body: Adding leave from "+ Add" on the employee page exempts both shares from the month the leave starts to the month before the month containing the day after it ends. Childcare leave that ends within the same month is exempt if it lasts 14 days or more.

care.title: Periods without long-term care premiums (exemption)
care.body: Even at ages 40 to 64, people who moved overseas (removed from the resident register) or entered an exempt facility do not pay long-term care premiums. Adding a period from "+ Add" on the employee page removes the care share from that month automatically. A training or business trip of about a month does not qualify unless the person is removed from the resident register.

agreement.title: Social security agreements (foreign nationals)
agreement.body: People sent from an agreement country who hold a certificate of coverage are not enrolled in the Japanese pension (and, for some countries, health insurance). Entering the certificate country and period in the employee edit screen adds agreement checks and certificate expiry items to the to-do list.

csv.title: Importing CSV, Excel and PDF files
csv.body: Employees and payroll records can be imported from CSV, Excel or PDF files. This app's template CSV goes straight to the review screen. Files with different headers, such as files exported from payroll or HR software, go through the "Match columns" screen, where you check which column goes to which field. Fields missing from the file can be filled with "Same value for everyone". Japanese era dates (R8.4.1) and Excel dates are read, and half-width katakana is converted to full width. Shift_JIS CSV saved from Excel can also be read.

myPage.title: Employee My Page and requests
myPage.body: Create an invitation link from "Personal info" on the employee page and send it to the employee. On My Page, employees can see their premium breakdown, answer requests and apply for changes such as their address. Answers and applications are reviewed under "Requests"; approving writes them to the employee record (with change history). To invite several people at once, select them in My Pages > Invites and accounts, press "Invite", and export the links as CSV (only people with a contact email; no email is sent automatically).

roles.title: Roles (administrator, general, employee) and the representative
roles.body: Administrators can register, edit, file and invite. General users can only view, and cannot see contact, commute and bank details or change history. Employees see only their own information on My Page. One administrator is the representative; only the representative can make other administrators general or remove them (so administrators cannot remove each other). Staff invitations are created under Members, and only someone who verifies the invited address can join. Administrators and general users can delete their own account at the bottom of Account settings (this cannot be undone). Owners must transfer the owner role first.

annual.title: Annual average (insurer calculation)
annual.body: If overtime and similar pay rise (or fall) at the same time every year because of the nature of the business or department, the standard monthly remuneration can be set by the annual average with the employee's consent. The app compares the regular average with the annual one (July to June for the annual determination; for monthly changes, the 3-month fixed-wage average plus the 12-month non-fixed average) and shows a candidate when they differ by 2 or more grades (1 grade near the upper or lower limit). Check "seasonal" and "consent" on the annual determination or revision page to apply it. One-off raises, a temporarily busy period, commuting allowance changes and the end of maternity or childcare leave are not eligible. Write "年間平均" in the remarks and attach the statement and consent form (every time).

filings.title: Filing lists (CSV for copying)
filings.body: In "Filing lists", choose a form (acquisition, loss, annual determination, monthly change, bonus payment) and a period, then press "Show" to list one person per row in the order of the form's numbered fields. Dates are in the Japanese era. You can also export CSV. My Number and address are not included. Remarks only include what the app records, so add anything missing. This is not the electronic submission format.

premiumList.title: Premium list marks (advance, 2+ offices)
premiumList.body: "Check advances" reads the pay for the deduction month and marks employees whose pay (cash) is less than their share with "Advance" and an estimated amount. The company pays it in advance and collects it later (the app does not record collection). "2+ offices" marks employees working at two or more offices; their premiums are split by the pension office, so the amounts are estimates. Check the notice.

display.title: Display (colors, menu, input)
display.body: Choose Light, Dark or Auto (follow the computer) in Settings > Appearance at the top right. Press the orange square at the top left to collapse the left menu to icons and widen the content. Both are remembered by the browser. In the payroll month and bonus tables, Enter and arrow keys move between cells (Enter moves to the next field in the employee form).

importMap.title: Match columns
importMap.lead: The file's headers differ from this app's fields. Columns were matched automatically; check which column goes to which field. Fields missing from the file can be filled with "Same value for everyone" (you can fix individuals later).
importMap.fileHint: You can choose CSV, Excel (xlsx, xls) or PDF. Files with different headers, such as exports from payroll or HR software, are matched on the next screen.
importMap.pdfNote: PDF tables are rebuilt from the positions of the text. Check in the examples that each value is in the right field.
importMap.employeeNote: If "Daily scheduled minutes" and "Scheduled days per week" are given, weekly hours (daily × days per week) and monthly days (days per week × 52 ÷ 12, rounded down) are calculated. Monthly days depend on the company's holidays, so correct them later if they differ from the contract.

error.tooBig: The file is too large (up to 5 MB).
error.badType: This file type cannot be read. Choose a CSV, Excel or PDF file.
error.empty: The file has no header row with at least one data row.
error.noText: No text could be read from the PDF (scanned PDFs cannot be read).
error.tooManyPages: The PDF has too many pages (up to 20).

members.title: Members
members.lead: Staff who use this office (administrators and general users). Employees' My Page accounts are invited from each employee's page.

roleHint.admin: Can register, edit, file and invite.
roleHint.general: View only (cannot see addresses, bank accounts or change history).

confirm.remove: Remove {{name}} from this office? They will no longer see this office's data.
confirm.transfer: Make {{name}} the representative? You stay an administrator.
confirm.demoteSelf: Make yourself a general user? You cannot make yourself an administrator again.
confirm.removeSelf: Leave this office? You will need a new invitation to come back.

error.unknown: Could not complete the operation. Please try again later.
error.notMember: You are not a member of this office.
error.notOwner: Only the representative can change or remove other administrators.
error.targetNotMember: This person is no longer a member.
error.ownerLocked: The representative cannot be changed. To leave, first make another administrator the representative.

rules.general: General: view only. Cannot manage members (can leave the office).
rules.admin: Administrator: invite, make general users administrators, remove general users. Cannot change other administrators (so a watcher always remains). Unless representative, can make themselves general or leave.
rules.owner: Representative (one of the administrators): can make other administrators general, remove them, and hand over the representative role. No one can change the representative; to leave, hand the role to another administrator first.

members.inviteLead: Create an invitation link and send it to the person (email, chat, etc.). Only someone who verifies the specified address can join. The link expires in 14 days.
members.linkHint: Send this link to the person. It only works after verifying the specified address, so the link alone cannot be used by someone else.

join.title: Join an office
join.lead: This is an invitation from an office administrator. Create an account with the invited email address, or sign in with your existing account.
join.emailHint: Register with the invited email address. A verification email will be sent.
join.signup: Create account and send verification email
join.sent: We sent a verification email to {{email}}.
join.step1: Click the link in the email (check your spam folder too).
join.step2: Come back to this page and press the button below.
join.notYetVerified: Your email is not verified yet. Click the link in the email, then press the button again.

accountPage.title: Account settings
accountPage.passwordSaved: Password changed. Use the new password next time you sign in.
accountPage.emailLead: We will send a verification email to the new address. The address changes when you click the link in that email (until then, the current address stays). After it changes, sign in again with the new address.
accountPage.employeeNote: This changes only the sign-in address. To change the contact email in the company's records, apply from "Apply for a change" on My Page.
accountPage.emailSent: We sent a verification email to {{email}}. Click the link in it to change the address.
accountPage.sameEmail: This is the same as the current address.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.owner: You cannot delete your account because you are the owner of: {{offices}}. First transfer the owner role to another administrator in "Administrators".
delete.gone: You will no longer be able to sign in to any office with this account, and you will be removed from the member lists. This cannot be undone.
delete.kept: The records you entered (employees, payroll, etc.) and the change history stay as the office's records.
delete.again: You can create a new account with the same email address later (you will need to be invited to the office again).

error.owner: You are the owner of an office, so you cannot delete your account. Transfer the owner role first.

home.hint: Filing is due on the 5th day, counting the day of the event as day 1 (enrollment, coverage-end, category change, age-70 and age-75 reports). Click a row to see why. Saving in a form window records the enrollment and the filing and removes the item.

myPages.lead: My Page status of current employees. Select people and press "Invite" to create invites that only work with the email in each employee's contact details. No email is sent automatically: export the links as CSV and send them yourself (for example with a mail merge).
myPages.hint: You can select people with no account and no usable invite. Invites expire after 14 days and can only be used by the person who clicks the link in the confirmation email.
myPages.noEmail: Skipped {{count}} without a contact email ({{names}}). Add the email on the employee page and select them again.

error.create: Could not create invites. Please try again later.

payrollEntry.new: No record for this month yet
payrollEntry.notEmployed: This employee was not employed during this pay period. Check the month.
payrollEntry.more: In kind, retroactive pay, absences, hours, status
payrollEntry.inKindHint: To calculate housing or meal amounts, use "Calculate" on the month page.

filing.title: Filing lists
filing.lead: Lists for copying onto the filing forms. Choose a form and period and press "Show" to list one person per row in the order of the form's fields. You can also export them as CSV.

hint.acquire: People whose acquisition date (the earlier of health and pension) is in the period. The monthly remuneration is the expected amount in the contract on that date.
hint.loss: People whose loss date is in the period (two rows if health and pension differ). Reaching 70 while employed uses a different form.
hint.regular: People whose annual determination was applied (those who keep the previous amount are not listed).
hint.irregular: Monthly changes applied from the revision candidates.
hint.bonus: People insured on the payment date.
hint.blank: Dates are in the Japanese era. My Number and address fields are not included. Remarks only include what the app knows. This is not the electronic submission format.

col.name: Name
col.over70NotApplicable: Date no longer an employee aged 70+

error.load: Could not load the data for the filing list.

premiumNotice.title: Payment reconciliation
premiumNotice.lead: Enter the amounts from the premium payment notice (arrives around the 20th of the next month, about {{arrival}}) and compare them with the app totals (monthly plus bonuses paid this month). The payment deadline is {{due}}.
premiumNotice.reasonsTitle: Reasons for the difference (check what you confirmed)

reason.acquireLoss: Acquisition or loss mid-month (app data differs from the filing)
reason.pendingFiling: Filing not yet processed by the pension office
reason.bonusFiling: Bonus filing missing or not yet processed
reason.excluded: Some employees could not be calculated in the app
reason.rounding: Rounding (monthly and bonus amounts are each rounded down, so 1–2 yen may differ)

premiumNotice.hint: The app totals add everyone's full premiums and round down below 1 yen, as the Japan Pension Service does. For months without bonuses, they should match the notice exactly. If they differ, check the reasons above. The notice is authoritative: adjust the difference in the employer share and submit any missing filings.

error.save: Could not save. Please try again later.

calendar.title: Year calendar
calendar.lead: Social insurance tasks for the next 12 months, starting this month. The to-do list shows what is due now; this calendar shows what is coming in the year. Click an item to open its page.
calendar.due: Payment deadline for last month's premiums: {{date}}
calendar.none: No tasks specific to this month.
calendar.hint: Tasks outside this app (year-end adjustment, resident tax, labor insurance renewal, etc.) are listed in gray so they are not missed. Bonus months come from the office settings.

task.payment: Pay last month's premiums (notice arrives around the 20th; reconcile in the premium list)
task.joinLeave: Joiners and leavers (acquisition and loss filings within 5 days)
task.watchRevision: Monthly changes for employees whose fixed wages changed (revision candidates)
task.ratesKyokai: Health and care insurance rates change (Kyokai Kenpo from March; deductions change from the month {{payMonth}} pay)
task.ratesKumiai: Check and register rates notified by the health insurance society (timing differs by society)
task.raise: Raise month: watch revision candidates (April–June pay is also used for the annual determination)
task.regular: Annual determination (July 1–10): set standard remuneration from September using April–June pay
task.regularApply: New standard remuneration from September (deductions change from the month {{payMonth}} pay)
task.dependentList: Dependent status list arrives (Kyokai Kenpo, late Oct to mid Nov); check dependent requirements
task.dependentDue: Dependent status list due (early December); file changes for dependents who no longer qualify
task.dependentKumiai: Dependent re-check (timing and method differ by health insurance society)
task.bonus: Bonus payment → bonus filing within 5 days
task.withholdingSlip: Withholding slips and statutory statements (by January 31)
task.residentTax: Resident tax notices (new amounts from June pay)
task.laborInsurance: Labor insurance annual renewal (June 1 to July 10)

review.title: Double check
review.selfNote: The requester cannot check their own work. Ask someone else.
